# Node reference

49 node types, in palette order. Open a file only for the types you are placing.

## Gates

| Type | Title | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`gate.and`](gate.and.md) | AND | Conjunction: |
| [`gate.or`](gate.or.md) | OR | Disjunction: |
| [`gate.not`](gate.not.md) | NOT | An inverter: |
| [`gate.nand`](gate.nand.md) | NAND | AND with the output inverted: |
| [`gate.nor`](gate.nor.md) | NOR | OR with the output inverted: |
| [`gate.xor`](gate.xor.md) | XOR | Exclusive OR: |
| [`gate.xnor`](gate.xnor.md) | XNOR | Exclusive NOR: |
| [`gate.buffer`](gate.buffer.md) | Buffer | Passes `A` through to `Y` unchanged. |
| [`gate.tristate`](gate.tristate.md) | Tri-state | A buffer that can **let go** of its output. |

## Inputs & outputs

| Type | Title | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`io.switch`](io.switch.md) | Switch | A latching input source. |
| [`io.button`](io.button.md) | Button | A momentary input: |
| [`io.keypad`](io.keypad.md) | Keypad | A pad of momentary keys — 0–9 as it comes — that drives the value of whichever key is held, with a strobe saying that one is. |
| [`io.keyboard`](io.keyboard.md) | Keyboard | A PC keyboard for the circuit. |
| [`io.drawpad`](io.drawpad.md) | Draw pad | A small grid of pixels you draw on with the pointer, and the circuit reads as bits — a hand-drawn glyph, sprite or bitmap without typing a ROM. |
| [`io.constant`](io.constant.md) | Constant | A fixed value, tied onto a net and never changing. |
| [`io.kickstart`](io.kickstart.md) | Kick-start | A single pulse when the simulation starts, and nothing afterwards — the power-on reset that gets a sequential circuit into a known state. |
| [`io.led`](io.led.md) | LED | A single-bit indicator. |
| [`io.probe`](io.probe.md) | Probe | A numeric readout of a whole bus, in the radix you choose. |

## Buses

| Type | Title | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`bus.split`](bus.split.md) | Split | Fans one bus out into narrower ones, least significant group first. |
| [`bus.merge`](bus.merge.md) | Merge | Joins narrow lanes back onto one bus, least significant group first. |
